patterns.label: Describing continuing situations from an earlier starting point
patterns.description: The learner repeatedly struggles with unassisted duration accounts and succeeds after complete models; no spontaneous recovery has yet occurred for duration.
conversation_contexts: Discuss the history of an ongoing activity or relationship
patterns.interpretation: Recurring spontaneous difficulties on independent dates; cause is not directly observed.
patterns.mode_note: Guided successes coexist with spontaneous difficulties; availability may differ by task, but retrieval cause is unproven.
unknowns: Transfer to new topics and registers is untested.
Opportunities do not prove avoidance; L1 transfer and retrieval causes remain hypotheses.

patterns.label: Natural personal uncertainty in conversation
patterns.description: An earlier unnatural uncertainty expression is followed by both controlled imitation and later unassisted appropriate use in a new context. Recent improvement warrants transfer observation rather than automatic reteaching.
conversation_contexts: Discuss an unresolved plan in a new topic
patterns.interpretation: Previously difficult; recent spontaneous successes suggest recovery. Transfer remains untested.
patterns.mode_note: Guided successes coexist with spontaneous difficulties; availability may differ by task, but retrieval cause is unproven.
unknowns: Transfer to new topics and registers is untested.
Opportunities do not prove avoidance; L1 transfer and retrieval causes remain hypotheses.

assumptions: Counts describe selected conversation evidence, not mastery or a representative proficiency score.
Repeated conversations on one date do not establish longitudinal recurrence.
Pattern descriptions and causal interpretations are model hypotheses; quotes and memberships are auditable.
